summary: App with a profile tab, leaderboard, and match history tracking. Focus is on fixing win streak calculation to use consecutive win/loss match data instead of days played.
architectural_notes: Win streak logic: Current streak = consecutive wins from most recent match backwards (reset on loss). Best streak = longest unbroken win sequence across full match history.
known_issues: Streak calculation was incorrectly counting consecutive days with availability/days played instead of consecutive wins from match data.

existing_features.title: Fix the current win streak calculation in the ProfilePage so it counts consecutive wins from the most recent match backwards through match history, stopping (resetting to 0) as soon as a loss is encountered. The streak must be derived from win/loss match records, not from days played or availability data.

Fix the best (all-time) streak calculation in the ProfilePage `computeBestStreak` helper so it scans the full match history in chronological order, increments a running counter on each win, resets it to 0 on each loss, and returns the highest value the counter ever reached. This must use win/loss match records exclusively.
Fix the win streak calculation displayed on the LeaderboardPage so it also uses consecutive wins from match history (same logic as REQ-1 and REQ-2), not days played or availability counts.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix win streak calculation in profile tab and leaderboard to use consecutive wins from match history instead of days played
